bio: Indulge in a luxurious Afternoon Tea at the elegant King Street Townhouse. Enjoy a selection of delicious treats in historic surroundings in this building that dates back to 1872.  Afternoon Tea is served in their Afternoon Tea Lounge, which provides diners with a stylish and sophisticated environment to enjoy their meal. The lounge is furnished with designer fabrics, atmospheric lighting and an array of locally commissioned art in a room that embraces the historic nature of the hotel while maintaining a contemporary feel.  Afternoon Tea at The King Street Townhouse is made up of quintessential hallmarks of the British tradition such as finger sandwiches, scones and homemade pastries & cakes. If you are feeling extra indulgent you can add a glass of Champagne. A children's Afternoon Tea menu is also available, priced at £16.50 per child.  King Street Townhouse is located in the heart of Manchester's City Centre, just a short distance away from Manchester Piccadilly Rail Station.  Traditional Afternoon Tea & High Tea for Two is priced at £65 for Two. Traditional Afternoon Tea with Champagne for Two or High Tea with a Cocktail for Two is priced at £90.
